According to Islamic tradition, the moon represents the divine guidance of Allah. The name Zulaym is a reminder of this guidance and the importance of living a life in agreement with Allah's divine will. It is also a symbol of hope, as the moon goes through various phases, yet remains a constant presence in the night sky, inspiring faith and perseverance in all of us.
